operation.body:
### Goal

Implement **FR-004**: users can filter the feedback inbox by category.

### Acceptance criteria

- Provide filter controls for `bug`, `feature request`, `other`, and **All** (shows every item).
- Each category filter shows only items in that category; **All** restores the full inbox ordering (newest first, id tie-break unchanged).
- When a filter yields no items, show a clear empty-state message (not a blank page).
- After an invalid category update, preserve the active filter selection while showing the error and keeping stored data unchanged; the submission form must remain usable (per `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` acceptance details).
- Filter controls are labelled and keyboard-accessible.
- Add automated tests for filtering each allowed category, **All**, and an empty filtered result at an appropriate boundary.
- Run `bin/rails test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement process-restart acceptance evidence (FR-005), broader invalid-request handling beyond category (FR-006), sample dataset or final docs pass (FR-008), or edits to `docs/security-review.md`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Process-restart evidence, missing-record handling beyond category updates, authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, and unrelated documentation churn.

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-003 are on `main` (goals #12, #14, #16; PRs #13, #15, #17): inbox index with category update forms. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-004 and acceptance details for filter preservation after invalid category updates.
